360	Like her husband, the child looks similar, because that is what one thinks about at the time of the act. So if it's by what one thinks, what is the proof that Yitzchak resembles
361	Avraham? Maybe she really was with Pharaoh, and she was thinking about her husband, and that's why he resembles
362	Avraham. Did you understand the question?
363	An amazing question, amazing. And he writes a brilliant answer, and if
364	Rabeinu Ovadia of Bartenura were here, I would go down and kiss his feet, if he were here.
365	Meanwhile Moshe kissed it. Did you hear his answer?
366	What is his answer?
367	He says: when does a woman think about her husband?
368	No, when she goes and does it willingly, only that he shouldn't catch me, only that he shouldn't see me, only that he shouldn't
369	come in, only that no spy should come up. Then her mind is on her husband the whole time.
370	But here, Sarah went to Pharaoh, and Avraham knows it.
371	Avraham knows, since he sent her to Pharaoh, he says to her, "Say you are my sister." You know they will take me to him, but
372	such a woman, you saw with your eyes that they took me, so she isn't afraid. And if she isn't afraid, she doesn't think
373	about her husband. If she doesn't think about her husband, lest he catch her, then the child shouldn't come out like her husband. If he isn't
374	supposed to come out like her husband, and he came out like her husband, how clearly it shows he is her husband's! Oh, how beautiful! Oh, how beautiful! There is nothing like
375	our Torah in the world. Repeat it, repeat.
376	I don't think he understood.
377	Did you understand the answer?
378	Brilliant.
379	It could be many things.
380	I'll tell you what Rabeinu Ovadia of Bartenura answered in his book, Amar Nekeh.
381	Another answer I found in Divrei David on the Gemara, who answers this way.
382	He says HaShem changed the facial features of
383	Yitzchak to resemble those of Avraham at that very moment. At that moment, Yitzchak
384	was born with different facial features, and two years later at the feast, when they began to murmur,
385	HaShem made a miracle, and at that moment the face changed. And since the face changed at that moment,
386	everyone knew that HaShem had made a miracle to show that this is his biological father, his real father. Did you understand
387	the answer?
388	Yes, one more answer from Moshe of Mosiof, the last one.
